claims.text: Saline sprays or ointments keep mucosa moist; can help prevent recurrence
claims.quote: Applying topical saline sprays or ointments to the nasal mucosa to ensure moisturization of the nasal mucosa can help prevent recurrent epistaxis.

claims.text: Tx may incl moisturizing or lubricating agents
claims.quote: topical vasoconstrictors, nasal cautery, and moisturizing or lubricating agents
claims.locator: Tunkel DE, et al. Clinical Practice Guideline: Nosebleed (Epistaxis). Otolaryngol Head Neck Surg. 2020;162(1 Suppl):S1-S38 (abstract, PubMed)
